answer: Tri-tree release gates hold each new answer until three established peers from distinct invite roots co-sign. First the author locks 25 POA for 48 hours. Second each co-signer stakes 30 POA outside the author's invite vine. Third a failed honeypot audit within ten epochs burns all four stakes. Fourth grading opens only after release. Freeing 100 clones costs ~3,000 POA co-signer stakes plus 2,500 POA author bonds and three invite trees grown via shale-hard review. Waiting for those roots to feed an oasis of trust is like needing three river sources before a desert town opens its gates.
